question: Least count corresponding to the main scale and circular scale of a screw gauge are 0.5 mm and 0.005 mm, respectively. A wire of diameter 2.675 mm is measured with the screw gauge. What would be the reading of divisions on circular scale of the screw gauge, if the zero error of the screw gauge is -0.02 mm?
